name: What preparation is needed before painting cabinets?

mainEntity.name: What preparation is needed before painting cabinets?

acceptedAnswer.text: Proper preparation is crucial for a durable and smooth cabinet finish. It involves thoroughly cleaning all cabinet surfaces to remove grease, grime, and residue. Next, doors and drawers are typically removed, and hardware is detached. Any imperfections like dings or scratches are filled and sanded smooth. Finally, all surfaces are lightly sanded to create a profile for primer adhesion, followed by a high-quality primer application. This meticulous prep work ensures the paint adheres properly and lasts.
acceptedAnswer.description: Preparation includes deep cleaning, removing doors and hardware, filling imperfections, sanding, and applying a quality primer. This ensures paint adhesion and durability.
